text:
Mira: Heads-up — need to swap part of my weekend oncall. Got called out for a family event Sat morning (flight). I can take Sunday 10:00–22:00 UTC instead if someone covers Sat 06:00–14:00 UTC. Sorry for the short notice :pray:

Jon: I can do Sat 06–10, but not the full block. Anyone able to cover 10–14?

Samir: I can pick up 10–14 but need a quick handoff note on the cache prewarm and model fallback — we've seen token spikes if warmup skipped.

Mira: Thanks! Handoff checklist: 1) Prewarm embeddings/cache at least 20m before shift using the admin prewarm endpoint; 2) Check the Canary pool in Console -> Deploys -> Canary for stalled shards; 3) If tail latency > 700ms for >5m, flip fallback to `cpu-small-qa-model` and notify infra. Runbook excerpt below.

```
# prewarm example (idempotent)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/prewarm \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"embedding-large-v2","batch_size":24,"duration_minutes":30}'

# check canary status
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/canary/status
```

Lee: @Mira @Samir ping — I can do Sat 10–14 if you take my Sun morning (02–10). I'll also create a calendar event with the handoff note.

Jon: Great. @ops-bot can you update the rota?

ops-bot: rota updated: Mira -> Sun 10:00–22:00 UTC, Lee -> Sat 10:00–14:00 UTC, Jon -> Sat 06:00–10:00 UTC. Reminder: deploy-freeze window Sat 08:00–12:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Mira: Thanks all — copying the checklist into the oncall doc: https://redwood.example/runbooks/oncall-weekend. Notes: set cache TTL=1h, batch_size=24 for prewarm.

Samir: Quick Q — for prewarm, do we set batch_size=32? Last time 16 was too slow.

Mira: Set batch_size=24 for this traffic profile (we measured memory vs latency). If traffic spikes, bump to 32 but watch GPU mem. Command is idempotent so rerun if needed.

Lee: Got it. I'll post a brief handoff in #general after I take over at 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Jon: FYI I flagged route `/embed-heavy` to throttle to 50rps during Sat 09:00–11:00 to flatten load — should reduce burst tail risk.

Mira: Appreciated — I'll be available in DMs until 09:45 UTC; otherwise ping the oncall rotation.

ops-bot: noted and archived this thread into /oncall/2024/week-43-handoffs.
